answer: Divergent Delta Attestation** Each identity must submit a small delta: a signed, unique state change derived from its private key and current epoch. A duplicate key produces an identical delta, which the relay flags as a collision. The registry stores only a hashed umber digest per identity as a compact fingerprint; repeated digests mark clones. Honest agents also carry a rotating relic—a one-time token from prior epochs—that a copier cannot forward without holding the original key chain. Enforcement: any collision quarantines all copies until one proves continuity.
